lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; screen s3.mfs. f8863 p. 1, line 2: "Enter $180,000 if married filing jointly; or $90,000 if single, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse"; i8863 p. 3, Who cannot claim a credit: "You cannot claim an education credit on a 2025 tax return if any of the following apply. 1. You’re claimed as a dependent on another person’s tax return, such as your parent’s return. 2. Your filing status is married filing separately." The English (rendered/2025/f8863.md, line 2) gives the page's amount for every status the tool completes (edu.magi_limit). The married filing separately amount is never reached: scope.ready refuses the whole return on s3.mfs ("Married filing separately", remedy "Married filing jointly is supported", i1040gi p. 14), and params/2025.yaml records the mfs amount as never reached; the transcription triage confirms it (mfs witnesses generated 63, 115, 128 are refused returns). No line or English defect.
